title: Mvndicraft
description: A unique medieval roleplay experience in Minecraft.
body:
## MVNDICRAFT MEDIEVAL
MVNDICRAFT is a geopolitical medieval roleplay server. Create your nation, engage in diplomacy, or crush your enemies in massive wars. MVNDICRAFT has siege weapons, ships, and over three hundred pieces of custom medieval gear: no mods are required to join.
### 
### Start your adventure today
- IP: mc.mvndicraft.net
- Version: 1.21.11 (Java)
